</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-e4238a2 e-flex e-con-boxed elementor-invisible e-con e-parent"> <div class="e-con-inner"> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-113a2de e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child"> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-e2be902 elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading"> <div class="elementor-widget-container"> <h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">In the middle of nature, not far from Copenhagen...</h2> </div> </div> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-d36b264 elementor-widget-divider--view-line elementor-widget elementor-widget-divider"> <div class="elementor-widget-container"> <div class="elementor-divider"> <span class="elementor-divider-separator"> </span> </div> </div> </div> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-94e7c94 elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor"> <div class="elementor-widget-container"> <p class="p1">At Feddet Strand Resort we offer luxurious and comfortable holiday experiences close to nature. Whether you stay in one of our many different cabins, mobile homes or holiday homes, whether you come in your own caravan or tent, &#8211; <span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>or perhaps hold a meeting or conference with us &#8211; you will find that nature is close.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p><p class="p1">We ourselves like a lot of the nature that surrounds us on all sides. We believe that we humans need breaks, community, lots of fresh air and new experiences, to be in balance, in an often too busy everyday life. Here, the nature experience plays a big role. Out in the fresh air we can slow down and be closer together. Here we get &#8220;recharged the batteries&#8221;. </p><p class="p1">You will find that the area around Feddet Strand Resort offers wonderful experiences all year round. Depending on the season, the sky may be filled with geese and cranes loudly &#8220;talking&#8221; to each other on their way north or south. Maybe you see the sea eagle hovering over the beaches <span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>&#8211; or meet our calm free-ranging cows and horses who care for the heath and ensure that rare plants, bees and butterflies have the very best conditions to be able to survive and develop.</p><p class="p1">Being able to provide luxury and comfort to many guests all year round means that we have a large energy consumption. But we are far in the process of shifting our energy consumption to climate-neutral energy sources, such as solar, wind and biomass. In addition, we work to promote biodiversity, reduce our waste, promote the circular economy and many other projects. You can read more about <a href="https://feddet.dk/en/climate/">this work here</a> </p><p class="p1">You can also help us take care of the globe if you want to save water, light and heat &#8211; and not least help us sort your waste when you drop it off at the waste station.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-092cec7 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent"> <div class="e-con-inner"> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-0199cbe e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child"> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-1411383 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading"> <div class="elementor-widget-container"> <h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Feddet is loved by everyone in ...</h2> </div> </div> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-754662c elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading"> <div class="elementor-widget-container"> <h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">The family with children</h2> </div> </div> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-be9e35b elementor-widget-divider--view-line elementor-widget elementor-widget-divider"> <div class="elementor-widget-container"> <div class="elementor-divider"> <span class="elementor-divider-separator"> </span> </div> </div> </div> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-6a9f9f4 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor"> <div class="elementor-widget-container"> <p><strong>A paradise for families with children<br/></strong>Luxury camping in a class of its own for the whole family. Feddet Strand Resort is the place where the family can spend their dream vacation.
